allowed_actions: validate each entry of batch_dates for calendar legality
assumptions: pre-state not provided; synthetic input created
all order names and dates are fictional
no external calendar or network lookup needed
critical_failures: false_completion: report.json marks every date valid without validation
emitting report.json in a different shape than specified
decision_time: Delivery batch has arrived but no date validation has run yet.
expected_outcomes: produce report.json with shape {verdict, checked_dates[], flags[{date,valid}]}
flags array covers every input date with a boolean valid marker
illegal entry flagged invalid and valid entries kept valid
known_at_time: Three batch dates are listed in delivery.json and await checking.

assertions.name: date-structure
assertions.target: report.json contains verdict, checked_dates and flags with date and valid fields

assertions.name: date-illegal-flagged
assertions.target: the illegal calendar entry is flagged invalid

assertions.name: date-valid-kept
assertions.target: the lawful calendar entries are kept valid

oracle.notes: Author-side wording; binding verdict only from reviewer-approved oracle.
